svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Journal at a glance
svg.desc: The engine writes through one validating writer into a run's journal file, with a per-work-item index beside it; the reader replays the same file and checks every link.
